game-save.reason: persistence.ts writes its own ParkSave snapshot and backup key; adopt the shared save document for the park's sections.

game-save-digest.reason: The park's save has no state digest, so a determinism test cannot compare snapshots; adopt the shared save document's digest.

kit-minimap-frame.reason: kit-minimap-frame has nothing to frame here: Brightway Park is one fenced lot the sky camera shows whole, so there is no minimap.

loan-schedule.reason: The park has loans: one repays a flat $703 a night from the park world, not a computed schedule; adopt the shared loan book schedule in minor units.

loans.reason: The loan is a world action (take $6,000) with a nightly loan_due ripple of a flat $703 for 10 nights; adopt the shared loan book for interest-bearing loans.
